Subject: [cdm-2015] VERY important yearbook email

So in the past couple hours, I've received a majority of the yearbook photos/dedications. Hooray! Clearly we have
nothing better to do on a Friday night (Sorry if you sacrificed exciting plans to work on yearbook stuff). In the attached
excel sheet (last updated 11:45PM), you'll find a checklist of things I have received. If you emailed/texted me things
and it's not checked off, please re-send ASAP!!! ALSO, feel free to change your name on the excel sheet to what you
want in yearbook (By default, we use your CDM names). LAST THING, fill in your undergraduate institution.
Thank you so so much for your cooperation!!!
